name: GET /api/leadflow/sla/attainment - the 95% report, with cause and recovery on every miss
description:
The SLA attainment report SOP §04 requires: at least 95% during business hours, with the cause and the customer recovery on EVERY miss (12ce1f53-ba07-4f62-a2ac-a0b065100b28#AC3), broken down by source, rep, day and hour, plus median and P95 first human attempt (12ce1f53-ba07-4f62-a2ac-a0b065100b28#AC4).

EVERY MISS CARRIES ITS CAUSE AND RECOVERY because a percentage on its own changes nobody behaviour. The breach table makes both mandatory, so a miss without them cannot exist to be reported - the guarantee comes from the schema rather than from this endpoint remembering to join.

PERCENTILES COME FROM THE ATTEMPT LEDGER, NOT FROM first_response_at, because the ledger knows which attempts actually COUNTED. Measuring from any recorded activity would report a median first attempt that nobody ever made - a task click would count as contact, which is precisely what the valid-human-attempt rule exists to prevent.

A NULL RATE IS NOT A PASS. An empty window has said nothing about the target rather than met it, so meets_target is false when there is nothing to measure. Reporting true would be a green light nobody earned, and an SLA report that is green by default is worse than no report. Verified live: an empty window returned rate null and meets_target false.

FOUR BREAKDOWNS FROM ONE ROW SET, so a slice cannot disagree with the total. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: The report carries the overall rate, the four breakdowns and every miss
NEGATIVE: an out-of-range window is refused rather than clamped
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: days must be an integer between 1 and 365
errorCases.when: an out-of-range window is requested. Refused rather than clamped: a caller who asked for 4000 days and silently got 365 would read the rate as covering eleven years.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
